highlights.title: A welcome that explains how kaizen works
highlights.text: New users see how a run goes, from ask to review, and the setup no longer ends until a project is added.

highlights.title: Chat works with Claude Code
highlights.text: Home Chat runs on Claude Code when it is your default agent or Codex is missing.

highlights.title: Agents offer kaizen's skills
highlights.text: Ask for a video, a deck or a plan in plain chat and the matching skill is offered first.

highlights.title: Permission prompts on the task page
highlights.text: When an agent waits for permission, Allow and Deny are on the task. Kaizen's own file reads no longer ask.

highlights.title: Plain words in Settings, and a real --help
highlights.text: Clear option names and hints, and kaizen --help lists every command.

fixes: A task no longer gets stuck after its review; "Looks good" comes back and finishes it.
Explore asks its questions before it starts investigating.
Steam Deck: the app uses software rendering, which stops the GPU crash.
The footer checks your connected phone every 15 seconds.
The last Claude usage reading is kept when its endpoint errors.
